Seedance 2.5 Prompt
Create a 15-second Japanese anime action-comedy with synchronized sound. Use the selected output aspect ratio.

STORY
A charges a world-ending spell through her staff. B notices its ordinary electrical cable and unplugs it from the wall. Every magical effect instantly switches off. End on A's familiar silent, stunned face.

REFERENCES
A = black-haired heroine from @Image 1. Her voice comes only from @Audio 1.
B = white-haired heroine from @Image 2. B has no voice reference and is completely silent.
Preserve exact faces, hairstyles, costumes, accessories, proportions and original 2D art styles. Images define identity, not poses, backgrounds or sheet layouts.
Exactly ONE A and ONE B. Equal standing height, excluding ornaments. No mixed identities or clones.
The staff is an added handheld prop; costumes stay unchanged.
VISUAL STYLE AND LOCATION
The heroines remain hand-drawn 2D anime with clean linework and cel shading.
Photorealistic fictional Shibuya rooftop at dusk: concrete, one rear wall and distant buildings. Match lighting and shadows while preserving illustrated faces.
Sharp violet magic, luminous arcs and sparks. Keep character silhouettes clear.
A stays screen-left; B stays screen-right near the wall socket. Both stand on the same level, about two meters apart. Keep screen direction and one consistent location.
No pedestrians, enemies, moving traffic or building destruction.

STAFF, CABLE AND SOCKET — CONTINUITY PRIORITY
ONE straight staff with a dark shaft and a simple round metal head containing a violet core. Its physical shape never changes.
A holds it upright in her right hand, with the base resting on the roof. She keeps this position during charging and unplugging.
ONE continuous black power cable is permanently attached to the staff's base. It runs visibly along the floor, then up to ONE white wall outlet beside B at waist height.
The cable ends in ONE ordinary black plug with two flat parallel metal pins.
The plug is fully inserted at the opening. All props already exist.
Keep this route and attachment. No extra cables, plugs or outlets.
B grips the plastic plug body with her right hand and pulls it straight out of the socket. She never pulls the cable itself or touches the pins.
The cable remains attached to the staff after unplugging. B continues holding the disconnected plug.
The spell stays fully active until the pins visibly clear the outlet. Only then does it switch off.
The staff, cable, outlet, characters and city remain physically intact. Only magical light and energy disappear.
VOICE
Exactly ONE spoken sentence.
Between 0.3 and 1.8 seconds, A confidently says in Japanese, using @Audio 1: 「せかいよ、おわれ！」
Synchronize only A's lips to this line. Finish before 2.0 seconds.
The audio reference defines her voice, not the script. Never replay its recorded words.
B produces no speech or vocal reaction.
After 2.0 seconds, neither heroine produces dialogue, improvised words, gasps, grunts, screams, sighs, laughter, humming or audible breaths. No narration or inner monologue.
Physical effects and ambience continue.
0.0–3.5s — OVERWHELMING MAGIC
Begin with a stable, dramatic medium-wide two-shot.
A holds the upright staff and speaks the single line. B stands beside the wall, calmly watching.
The violet core ignites. A huge luminous sphere forms directly above the staff head, linked to it by a short energy column.
The sphere expands to approximately three meters across. Violet arcs circulate around it, sparks climb upward and a magical wind lifts the heroines' loose fabric and hair slightly.
Use powerful light and bass; both characters stay in place.
The spell is charging only. No projectile, beam or actual world destruction.
Keep A's speaking face readable. No obscuring smoke or white flash.
3.5–6.0s — THE ORDINARY POWER SOURCE
Cut to a clear view of the staff base, the black cable on the floor and its route toward B's wall outlet.
A's spell remains active at the same intensity.
B follows the cable with her eyes, then looks at the plug. Her lips stay closed. No conversation or invitation gesture.
Briefly frame the fully inserted plug and outlet as an ordinary household connection.
By 6.0 seconds, B's right hand has grasped the plastic plug body. It remains inserted. She has not disconnected it yet.
Do not move the staff or detach the cable from its base.
6.0–9.0s — UNPLUGGING ENDS EVERYTHING
Cut to a locked three-quarter view that includes B's hand and outlet clearly in the foreground, with A's staff and active magical sphere visible to the left.
Keep the extraction and magical shutdown in ONE continuous shot.
Around 8.0 seconds, B pulls the plug straight out once. Show a brief separation with both metal pins visibly outside the socket.
At that exact moment, the giant sphere, energy column, violet arcs, sparks and magical wind all switch off together.
The sphere vanishes instantly like a powered light. No fade, explosion or second spell.
The staff's core becomes dark while its metal head and shaft stay unchanged.
The scene returns to its original dusk lighting, not total darkness.
Stop the music and magical roar at disconnection. A small plastic click and a brief descending power-down sound, then quiet.
B keeps holding the unplugged black plug. Her mouth stays closed.
9.0–12.0s — THE AWKWARD REALIZATION
Return to the original medium two-shot.
A remains in her grand casting pose, holding the now-inert staff upright.
She looks up at the empty space where the sphere was, then down toward the staff and across to the disconnected plug in B's hand.
Her proud smile disappears.
B remains relaxed beside the outlet, holding the plug near her waist. No conversational gestures or vocals.
Let the exposed power connection explain the joke.
Clearly show the empty outlet and intact cable.

12.0–15.0s — THE FAMILIAR FACE
Cut to A's face.
Preserve her exact reference features. Eyes widen, pupils become slightly smaller, eyebrows rise and lips part once into a small stunned expression.
Hold the mouth still afterward. No repeated lip movements or vocal sound.
Use her familiar uncomprehending face, without crying, blush or an exaggerated scream.
Apply a short, controlled push-in. Hold the final full second.
End directly on A's silent face. No cut back, reconnection or extra gag.
SOUND
Opening: dramatic instrumental percussion, low strings, a deep magical charging hum and sharp energy crackles. No choir or vocal samples.
The ordinary plug click must be distinct.
At disconnection, abruptly remove the music, charging hum and energy sounds. Allow only the short power-down sound.
Afterward, faint rooftop wind and distant city ambience. No comedy sting or canned laughter.
EXCLUDE
Text, subtitles, logos, watermarks, HUD, clones, extra limbs or fingers, fused hands, redesigns, injury, electrocution, gore, camera rotation or extra characters.

The camera enters the studio.

prompt seedance 2.0 

Create a 15-second photorealistic cinematic villa film using the uploaded reference sheet as the strict visual guide.

REFERENCE:
The sheet shows three views of one tropical villa: exterior, living room, and pool terrace. Use each panel to guide its corresponding shot. The video must show full-screen scenes, never the reference sheet itself, a collage, panel borders, or labels.
Maintain the villa’s cream limestone walls, flat roof, teak accents, glass doors, ivory sofa, wooden coffee table, travertine terrace, rectangular infinity pool, and two loungers. Preserve the architecture and furniture placement across shots.

0–5 SECONDS — EXTERIOR
Begin with the exterior composition from the first reference panel, looking across the pool toward the villa. Slowly move the camera forward at eye level. Gentle ripples animate the reflections. Palm leaves sway slightly. Warm interior lamps glow behind the glass. Keep the entire building stable and sharply defined.

5–10 SECONDS — LIVING ROOM
Clean cinematic cut to the interior composition from the second reference panel. The ivory sofa and wooden coffee table occupy the foreground, with the pool and forested valley visible through the open glass doors. Slowly slide the camera to the right, creating subtle natural parallax. The sheer linen curtain moves gently in the breeze. Warm sunlight reveals the fabric and stone textures.
10–15 SECONDS — POOL TERRACE
Clean cut to the third reference composition: villa on the left, infinity pool on the right, green valley beyond. Slowly move backward along the terrace to widen the view. Small ripples catch the sunlight. Ease the camera to a stop during the final second, ending on an elegant architectural composition.

CINEMATOGRAPHY:
Premium architectural film, natural golden-hour lighting throughout, restrained warm color grading, realistic exposure, straight vertical lines, smooth stabilized movement, and clearly visible material textures. Moderate wide-angle lenses without distortion. Quiet, intimate, luxurious atmosphere.
SOUND:
Soft water movement, a gentle breeze, distant birds, and understated ambient music without vocals. Continuous sound across the cuts.

AVOID:
People, text, logos, changing architecture, moving furniture, warped walls, distorted glass, flickering textures, sudden lighting changes, extreme lens flare, fast camera movements, speed ramps, and morphing transitions.

Seedance 2.5 prompt👇
15s, 16:9, 7-shot continuous narrative, realistic human anatomy, live-action textures, Chinese fantasy martial arts and sleeve magic. Start immediately in close combat at a moonlit abandoned gas station. Rhythm: short collisions, body-check pressure, compressed verbal warning, then one heavy palm strike and a gold-petal magic burst to break the encirclement.

[Reference roles]
@image1 = identity only for 8 zombies, one each: tall thin hoodie man, short stocky worker man, tall office woman, apron housewife, hunched old man, short old woman, male student, girl in sportswear. Same character across front/side/back views. Keep gray dead skin, cloudy eyes, dirty modern clothing. Ignore gray background, labels, turnaround layout.
@image2 = only adult heroine identity and costume: black hair in high bun, gold floral crown with hanging beads and white flowers, ivory and pale-cyan layered long dress, translucent embroidered wide sleeves, gold floral waist ornament. Lock face, makeup, proportions, hairstyle, fabric structure. She is always empty-handed.
@image3 = only location: abandoned gas station, canopy pillars, fuel pumps, convenience store behind, road and old GAS sign on the left, wet cracked concrete, puddles, mountain forest, cloudy moonlit night. Keep all landmarks and equipment positions fixed. Keep original physical signage. Ignore collage borders and explanatory text.

[Space lock]
World orientation never flips: convenience store behind, open forecourt ahead, road and GAS sign on the left. Heroine starts in the passage between the two front fuel pumps near the canopy front edge, facing the open forecourt. All close combat stays inside this passage within about 2 meters. From 5.00s to 8.80s she is pressured backward exactly two steps toward the store, about 1 meter total: left foot back first, then right foot back, ending left foot forward, right foot back. She never goes behind the pumps. Dress wraps around the pump bases naturally, feet fully land on the ground.
Tall thin zombie attacks from front-left and gets knocked into the left-front pillar, then braces on it and re-enters from beside the pillar. Worker zombie attacks repeatedly from center front and must plant, turn back, and re-enter after each deflection or setback. Office woman attacks from left-front and is knocked back to outer left-front. Sportswear girl circles around the outside edge of the left pump and enters from left-front only after passing the front end of the machine, never through it. Housewife, old man, old woman, and male student fill from the deeper front layer in staggered timing. Fallen zombies stay where they land, no reset.
Camera stays on the heroine’s right-side half-space, using the line between heroine and worker zombie as the main combat axis. Usual framing: heroine left of frame, front zombie group right of frame. The overhead angle remains under the canopy, never above the roof.

[Look and light]
Cold blue-gray moonlit night with old-gold magic. Palette: deep midnight blue-black #14212D, cold gray-cyan #71838A, ivory #E8E1D2, pale jade #B8C8BC, aged gold #C5A05A. Natural warm skin for heroine around #D0AD97, zombies remain dead gray. Low saturation, medium-high contrast, rich readable shadows, soft highlight rolloff, light film grain. Preserve skin, wet fabric, embroidery, rusted metal, puddle texture. Main cool moonlight from upper left, weak 4000K canopy lamp, faint warm store glow. White balance and exposure stay stable across all shots. Gold petals add only local warm reflections on face edge, hands, sleeves, puddles, fading with distance. Night mood always remains dark and believable.

[Performance and body physics]
Heroine’s goal is to stop the zombies from crashing into her body and open the front passage. Her eyes lock first on wrist, shoulder, or chest, then head and torso follow. After each hit she confirms target briefly and instantly shifts to the next threat. Natural blinking, small eye adjustments, moist eye reflections. Tight mouth line, slightly tucked jaw, short exhales on strikes. When compressed backward, right shoulder and upper back visibly jolt, brows tighten, one forced inhale escapes. After the second planted step, jaw loosens slightly, weight sinks, gaze narrows onto the worker’s chest and shoulder, then she delivers the warning and attacks immediately.
Combat language: short palm crashes, forearm interceptions, waist-driven sleeve strikes. Force travels from planted foot to knee, hips, waist, shoulder, arm. Contact causes local compression, then immediate release into the next action. No long palm push against the chest. Zombies keep forward inertia after their arms are deflected. Missed attacks need recovery steps and turning. Hit reactions show cloth compression, torso deflection, balance loss, step compensation, pillar impact, water splash. Wide sleeves accelerate from the arm root, sleeve ends lag and whip, then settle. Skirt follows real leg path. Waist ornament and dangling beads swing back briefly and lightly click. The high bun and crown stay firm. Heroine’s chest has only subtle fabric-constrained inertia from breath, sudden stop, waist twist, and impact, quickly fading.

[Magic and environment]
Only one main magic: gold-petal force generated from the embroidered sleeve openings.
